subject: Enforce span taxonomy from §6.5 across the codebase
description:
Build `capo/observability/spans.py` with helpers/decorators producing the span names + attributes from §6.5. Add the spans at every required site: boot, webhook in, dispatcher handle, agent run, tool execution, delegation spawn/monitor/complete, AMC send, memory compact, budget cap, approval lifecycle.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Every span in §6.5 is emitted at the documented site with the documented attributes.
- [ ] All spans propagate the parent trace ID.
- [ ] All errors include exception class + message attributes.
- [ ] `capo.tool.<name>` uses the agent-facing tool name (snake_case) per §6.5 footnote.
- [ ] Span name format strictly matches §6.5 (no drift in punctuation or casing).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Spans suppressed when `observability.logfire_enabled=false` (no-op decorator).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: each helper produces span with expected name + attributes (mocked Logfire)
• Integration: end-to-end CC delegation produces spans for boot → webhook → dispatcher → agent → tool → spawn → monitor → complete → notify, in correct parent/child relationships

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 6.5, 9.5
